newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary may open forex futures to foreigners - agency.
newsitem.headline: Hungary may open forex futures to foreigners - agency.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary will look into easing restrictions on foreign exchange trading and may open the futures and forwards markets to foreigners, a bank official said on Thursday.

A decision on opening the forwards and futures market to foreigners could be made at the NBH's meeting in June, NBH vice president Zoltan Bodnar was quoted as saying in an interview with MTI-Econews news agency.
"Although it is premature to suggest an outcome of the review by the NBH board, I would not exclude the possibility of a positive decision," Bodnar was quoted as saying.
Bodnar's office in Budapest said he had left for the day and was not reachable for comment.
The proposed change would come as part of a general easing of restrictions on the forex market, which has long been sought by Hungarian foreign exchange dealers.
The dealers say the present restrictions put them at a competitive disadvantage.
